summary: Bullish filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release and unaudited monthly metrics for April 2026, including trading volume and average spreads for Bitcoin and Ethereum. No transaction, corporate event, or strategic development is reported — only routine operational data. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves the same function as a voluntary earnings or operational update under US reporting. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. No special-situation activity is present; the filing is purely informational and not actionable for event-driven analysis.
